guides.title: 2027학년도 3월 입학(봄학기) 외국인전형 모집요강
guides.submission_channel: online application via Jinhak Apply (from https://oisa-admission.sogang.ac.kr/) + documents by registered post (incl. international express), in person, courier or quick service to Sogang OISA, Woojung Hall #201 — arrival by deadline
notes: The PDF has no text layer (image only); all evidence strings were transcribed from the rendered page images of the Korean section, so minor transcription differences are possible.
Page references are the printed page numbers of the Korean section (PDF page = printed page + 1). The file also contains EN/CN/JP versions.
Application 2026-10-12 10:00 ~ 2026-11-20 17:00 (rolling, 24h); documents 2026-10-12 10:00 ~ 2026-11-20 17:00, arrival by deadline, no in-person on weekends/holidays. Results 2026-12-24 (p.3).
Upload path dated 20260909; PDF metadata modified 2026-09-09. No publication date printed.

General rules p.11: originals in principle (copies certified by the issuing body or Sogang's submission desk allowed if originals impossible); non-English foreign-language documents need a notarized translation; academic documents must be translated/notarized and then apostilled or consular-confirmed, originals only; all documents issued within 1 year of the application deadline.
No language proof required for 로욜라국제대학 글로벌융합학부 (p.7, p.10).

p.11 #2 limits translation to documents in a foreign language other than Korean/English, while the Appendix A checklist (p.19) marks 번역공증 O for foreign-school certificates without that qualifier; the checklist states it is for reference only and PART 5 governs. translation_required=true is recorded with that caveat.
